title: Father's brass band in Colonna
summary: His father Charlie played B-flat trumpet in a 15-piece brass band and in small dance bands in the hometown of Colonna; New Orleans musicians sometimes came to play there.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us what you remember of your mother and father? You mentioned your father was a musician you told me a minute ago.
Well, I remember that my father...
Y'all want to see this card on the card if I get?
That's all right. That's all right. I remember my father was in a brass band. He played the brass band. What was his instrument? His instrument was a B-flat trumpet.
B-flat trumpet. What was his name, his first name?
Charlie Rublo. Charles. Mm-hmm.
Did they have a brass band in St. Charles?
They had a brass band at that time.
Well. Was it like the bands here? Did they sound a good deal like as far as you can remember?
It's been a long time since they had been. Absolutely. Absolutely. That was real music. Absolutely sound.
About how big a band was it?
Do you remember? They had 15 pieces. Really? A little bigger than the years now. Yeah, that's right. 15 pieces. Brass band.
Mm-hmm. Did they have many parades there?
Well, now and then it had parades in our hometown.
Did they ever play for dances? Did they have any dance music? Did the brass band play for dances by any chance?
Well, not as I remember.
Yeah. Do you remember what kind of dance bands they had?
Well, I do remember you used to have four and five pieces of dance band. Did your father play in any of those? Was he playing?
Yeah. Oh, yes. He was playing.
For dances, too. He was playing. Mm-hmm.
Did they sound much different than the small jazz bands they have here now? Or how did the music sound in those days, if you can remember? What kind of music you heard?
Well, the kind of music that I heard was the same Dixieland music that they're playing now. And other words, they had some very good musicians in that band.
Did any musicians from New Orleans ever come up there that you heard?
Well, now there's musicians from New Orleans used to come out into my hometown to play, too. What is the name of the town? Was it the... Colonna, Louisiana.
Colonna. Oh. What other larger town is that? Is it near Baton Rouge up that way? No. Or Lafayette or how? What's the direction? I don't know.
No, that's about nine miles from Lulon. Lulon. Lulon.
It's up the river there.
Mm-hmm. On the other side. On the other side.
I remember. I was over there once.
Huh?
